findings.description: In the Change 5 srcOpt clone path, both cover_image and image fields are not explicitly normalized — they are spread from srcOpt as-is. If srcOpt has one field populated and the other absent, the sidebar and board renderers both use cover_image||image fallback so parity holds in practice. But dev should consider explicit normalization for defensive correctness.
findings.proposed_fix: In the push call inside Change 5, normalize both image fields: const img = srcOpt.cover_image || srcOpt.image || null; push({...srcOpt, cover_image: srcOpt.cover_image || img, image: srcOpt.image || img, ...other_fields}). This makes both image fields consistent regardless of source data shape.

findings.description: The srcOpt lookup loop in Change 5 iterates Object.keys(dayEntry.slots) — all slot keys, not just meal slots. A corrupt duplicate option_id in an activity slot could cause a cross-contamination false match. In practice this is unlikely but not impossible.
findings.location: scripts/lib/react_template.tpl — new srcOpt loop in Change 5
findings.proposed_fix: Restrict loop to meal slots: for (const sKey of Object.keys(dayEntry.slots).filter(k => MEAL_SLOTS.has(k))). MEAL_SLOTS is already in scope at line 2226.

out_of_scope_observations.description: Direct board-to-board meal moves (dragging from breakfast board slot directly to lunch board slot, no sidebar intermediary) do not copy option objects in editorTripData. If user then drags that lunch board card to sidebar, Change 5 may find the option still in breakfast slot and synthesize from there. This is outside the AC1-AC3 scope of the 5 changes (spec scope is board→sidebar→board).

The spec's AC3 rationale comment says 'finds the option in slots[meals-any].options[] itself (it wasn't removed yet at synthesis time)'. This is only true for the very first board→sidebar drop before any applyBridge call. After applyBridge has executed (which it always does for meals-any→concrete-slot drops), the option lives in the concrete slot, not meals-any. Both code paths produce correct results; the spec explanatory comment is slightly imprecise.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: 5 findings from gpt-5.5 xhigh reasoning: (1) draft description used double-quotes for Change 4 old string which uses single quotes — cosmetic wording only; (2) AC2 srcOpt clone path does not explicitly normalize both image fields — parity works via fallback but explicit normalization is more defensive; (3) srcOpt lookup scans all slots not just MEAL_SLOTS — cross-contamination risk low but resolvable; (4) out-of-scope: direct board-to-board moves without sidebar intermediary don't move option objects; (5) confirmed QA's own AC3 rationale correction. Net codex verdict: no hard blocker against PASS for the proposed changes.
